judgment: A two-role global-context input ablation is a narrow test of information gain. It preserves the load-linear basis, query38, global32, decoder, fixed calibrated gradient coefficient and sampling budget. It is not a new algorithm, causal diagnosis of previous failures, or demonstrated generalization.

pair_contract.pair: matched NEW zero-role versus actual-role; no historical three-channel run is a gate comparator

role_mode.actual: same xyz plus support_union and load_member binary channels

role_definition.padding: same original mask; padded roles zero and excluded from max/mean pooling

pair_contract.role_source: only canonical ver aligned input original25 features in unchanged FEM-node order; no target or case ID input
pair_contract.cloud: exact same saved 45-CAD seed2026 points/mask/cad_keys/node_indices; 1024 valid points per CAD; no resampling or role-aware sampling

encoder.pool: unchanged masked max plus masked mean
encoder.initialization: zero and actual must have identical complete 5-input model parameters, including new role-column weights, and identical decoder initialization; old 3-input first layer is not a matched baseline

pair_contract.load_linearity: only query feature slots7:13 masked in linear basis; role geometry context remains load-independent for a CAD; external alpha combines response basis

loss_and_budget.per_case_node_rows: 6400 uniformly sampled original nodes +1600 uniform tetrahedra x4 corner rows; duplicated rows retained in both branches
loss_and_budget.relative_case_u_and_strain_normalizers: unchanged existing train-only normalizers; no scaler/cache refit
loss_and_budget.same_precision: existing TCNN/PointNet settings and FP64 physical P1 arithmetic

split.CAD_grouping: all loads of a CAD stay in its fixed group

pair_contract.same_schedule: same evaluation/checkpoint cadence, optimizer/init streams and sampled cases/nodes/tetrahedra; verify sampling witness equality
pair_contract.checkpoint_selection: minimum known-validation15 mean all-original-node physical uXYZ vector relativeL2 only; no P1, dia, stress, finaltest or gate-based checkpoint selection

recommended_predeclared_gate.comparator: new matched zero-role branch at its u-only-selected checkpoint; actual branch at its own u-only-selected checkpoint
recommended_predeclared_gate.metric_scope: same15 validation CAD/load cases, all original FEM nodes, physical signed uXYZ and same volume-averaged all10-node recovered corner-P1 symmetric Frobenius metric
recommended_predeclared_gate.zero_strain_baseline: Separately, predicting zero strain tensor has relativeL2=1 on each nonzero-reference case, hence mean1. This is NOT the zero-role model. Check nonzero reference denominators; do not call training P1 loss or signed scalar stress this diagnostic.
recommended_predeclared_gate.threshold_policy: strong preregistered gate; do not relax thresholds or choose alternative best-by-strain snapshots after observing results
recommended_predeclared_gate.record_train: at both selected checkpoints record train120 all-original-node u mean/worst and P1 mean, alongside existing training histories; use identical definitions, not best-train values from different checkpoints
recommended_predeclared_gate.finite_and_matching: a failed finite metric or mismatched contract is invalid comparison, not gate success

input_metadata_proof.node_indices_note: Current metadata confirms exact points/mask hashes and prior coverage confirms point-to-index mapping. This review did not open node_indices arrays or newly prove current-run index equality. Implementation must reuse the SAME saved artifact and log node_indices/cad_keys/role hashes rather than regenerating indices from seed or matching coordinates.

source_lines.fact: existing xyz3 PointNet and unchanged shared condition path; five-input wrapper needs truthful shape/config records
roles originate from aligned deck interface members and support DOF flags
same-CAD nonload features preserved; only force/moment slots replaced

limitations: support_union collapses DOF identity, master/patch identity and individual four-support membership; binary marked points plus pooled PointNet do not encode explicit patch adjacency/topology.
Current sampled support15-43 and load7-21 nodes per CAD are sparse; presence of a union/load role does not establish individual support-patch coverage, full interface shape, or adequate mechanics.
Clouds sample unique original FEM nodes, not uniform surface area. Role point proportions can depend on mesh density; preserve the existing sample to isolate this hypothesis.
Same CAD roles are load-independent under the existing guard; this cannot introduce arbitrary new interfaces/constraints or claim transfer to new BC layouts.
Different first-layer fan-in changes parameterization versus old xyz3, so historical comparisons remain contextual. New zero/actual are the causal matched information ablation.
CAD validation informs selection and stage gate; it is not finaltest, multiple-seed statistical significance, or proof of novel physics.

failure_interpretation_and_stop.train_and_validation_no_improvement: no observed gain from these sparse two-role summaries at fixed architecture/budget/seed; representation compression or optimization remain possible. Do not conclude BC information is irrelevant.
failure_interpretation_and_stop.train_improves_validation_does_not: role-conditioned fit gain does not transfer to held-out CADs under this split; do not claim generalization or remedy via blind second seed/parameter sweep.
failure_interpretation_and_stop.strain_gain_u_gate_fail: a derivative-quality/point-displacement tradeoff remains; do not count strain-only gain as success.
failure_interpretation_and_stop.if_all_pass: report only the matched effect on fixed train40/validation5 known loads; further action remains parent decision.
failure_interpretation_and_stop.no_automatic_followup: No blind second seed, threshold relaxation, sampling/capacity change, coefficient sweep, dia/finaltest opening or stress expansion follows from this note.
